title: Add remove-win and remove-loss actions to Leaderboard and persist decrements

requirements.text: Update the Leaderboard tab UI to include two additional buttons, “Remove Win” and “Remove Loss”, displayed immediately next to the existing “Win” and “Loss” add buttons in the date-selection action row.

quotes: on the leaderboard tab when users enter the wins and losses, there is only buttons to add wins and losses however I want an additional one to remove wins and losses

acceptanceCriteria: In the Leaderboard page action area (where a user selects an available date), there are now four buttons: Win, Loss, Remove Win, Remove Loss.
The new remove buttons are positioned directly next to the existing add buttons (same control group).
User-facing button labels are in English.

requirements.text: Implement remove-win/remove-loss behavior in the frontend so that clicking “Remove Win” or “Remove Loss” decrements the corresponding count by 1 for the selected day, never allowing the day’s wins or losses to go below 0, and shows success/error toasts consistent with the existing add-win/add-loss flows.
acceptanceCriteria: If no date is selected, clicking either remove button shows an error toast and does not call the backend.
If a date is selected and the day has at least 1 win (or loss), clicking the corresponding remove button results in a success toast and updated leaderboard/match history data.
If the selected day’s win (or loss) count is already 0, the operation does not produce negative values; the UI remains consistent with backend state (no negative counts shown).
While a record/remove mutation is pending, the action buttons are disabled in a way consistent with current Win/Loss behavior (preventing double submits).

requirements.text: Add React Query mutations for removing a daily win and removing a daily loss that call new backend actor methods, and invalidate the same query keys as the existing recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss mutations (callerStats, leaderboard, callerMatchHistory).
acceptanceCriteria: Two new hooks exist in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for remove-win and remove-loss.
On success, the hooks invalidate at least: ['callerStats'], ['leaderboard'], and ['callerMatchHistory'] (matching existing add-win/add-loss invalidations).
The Leaderboard page uses the new hooks for the remove buttons.

requirements.text: Extend the Motoko backend to support decrementing a caller’s daily wins/losses for a given day (selected in the UI), updating the same underlying storage used by recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss, never allowing wins/losses to go below 0, and recomputing overall stats afterward so the leaderboard reflects the change.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes two new shared methods for the caller: one to remove a daily win for a day, and one to remove a daily loss for a day.
Both methods enforce the same authorization guard pattern as recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss (user permission required).

Both methods do not allow the stored daily log to become negative (wins and losses are Nat). If the count is already 0 or no log exists for that day, the backend leaves the value at 0 (no underflow) and does not corrupt state.
After a successful decrement/no-op, the caller’s overall stats are updated so getLeaderboard() returns updated totals.
The existing recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss behavior continues to work unchanged.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit any frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
nonGoals: Changing leaderboard ranking/sorting/scoring logic beyond what naturally changes from updated win/loss totals.
Adding new authentication methods (Internet Identity remains the only auth).
Adding per-click confirmation dialogs or audit/history tracking beyond existing dailyLogs and derived stats.
